annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Communications and Digital Technologies (DCDT), South Africa; Mashishi, A.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a national AI plan aligning government, private sector, academia and civil society on AI priorities.
Builds on PC4IR report and the AI Institute of South Africa (AIISA) and CAIR.
Proposes AI and data governance structures, including a Ministerial Advisory Council or expert panel.
Recommends contextual, proportional regulation with disclosure, explainability and accountability frameworks.
Sets priority focus areas, enablers and adoption timelines (e.g., 2024 milestones).
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Draft discussion document by South Africa's DCDT outlining a national AI plan for government adoption of AI. It reviews global AI discourse, the PC4IR approach, enablers, ethics, a proposed regulatory approach and governance structures, with priorities and timelines. It is general AI policy without robotics-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: South Africa's Artificial Intelligence (AI) Planning: Adoption of AI by Government
annotation.title_en: South Africa's Artificial Intelligence (AI) Planning: Adoption of AI by Government
